A '''[[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]]''' gave the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] information on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] plans as they were holding his family captive. The [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] decided to send [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] and a group of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to find him on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Mundi and his [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] ambushed the senator while he was giving Confederate agents [[Messo]] and [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] a recording of the Republic's war plans. He was betrayed by Messo, and Ventress slashed him across the chest with her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. After killing all of the clones, Ventress blew up Mundi's [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]], and escaped. The senator died of his mortal chest wound. Just before he died, however, he told Master Mundi that his aide would rendezvous with the Separatists on [[Mon Gazza/Legends|Mon Gazza]].
